title: Mixpanel MCP Server Beta Now Supports ChatGPT and Gemini!
summary: Exciting Update... Mixpanel MCP Server beta now also supports ChatGPT and Gemini 🎉 | @everyone Ready to get started? Check out the help docs with the step-by-step instructions for ChatGPT (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#option-5-chatgpt-openai) and Gemini (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#option-4-google-gemini-cli). This beta is available to all projects based in US data center; we're working to expand this to EU and IN! Here are some resources to learn more & get started: • Implementation Docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview) (reminder: Organization admins must enable the beta feature first in Settings > Org > Overview) • Mixpanel MCP Server blog (https://mixpanel.com/blog/mixpanel-mcp-server/) And as always, we want to hear from you! Share your feedback with the team directly via the form on the docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview).
